sloka: उपद्रुतमिदम् सर्वमनालम्बमनायकम् ।कैकेय्या हि कृते सर्वम् विनाशमुपयास्यति ॥२-४८-२५॥
transliteration: upadrutamidam sarvamanālambamanāyakam ।kaikeyyā hi kṛte sarvam vināśamupayāsyati ॥2-48-25॥

translations.english: The entire kingdom, for the sake of Kaikeyi, is under a great calamity. With no support or leader it will definitely go to ruin.
